synopsis: Diffusion models are listed among data-learned sensor modelling approaches, alongside GANs, neural rendering, learned noise or measurement models, world models, and learned real-to-synthetic transformations [f4483]. Chapter 6 specifically includes diffusion models among learned camera simulation methods [f4565]. Chapter 9 warns that generative models, including diffusion models, can produce plausible but physically wrong scenes, so visual plausibility alone does not establish physical correctness [f7096]. The supplied facts identify their potential use and this limitation, but provide no diffusion-specific performance figures or validation results [f4483, f4565, f7096].

relations.note: Specifies camera simulation as a use within the broader learned sensor modelling category.
Adds a physical-correctness risk to the listed generative sensor modelling approaches.
Qualifies learned generative camera simulation with the risk of plausible but physically wrong scenes.
